function.description: The single aggregate read - users, shifts, availability requests, time off, shift templates, day caps, swap posts/claims. Call this first to resolve names to ids and see what already exists before writing anything.

function.name: shift_update
function.description: Move or edit an already-scheduled shift. Immediate - no separate approval step. Send only the fields being changed.
